description:
causal::Cause (Initial/Content/Readiness/Uncaused) and scheduler::WorkStartReason (Ignition/ChangedRevisionWake/ActivationFrontier/BlockedWaiterExpansion/Unclassified) are the same question answered twice, in two vocabularies, by two components at two times.

The tell: Uncaused and Unclassified are both the no-sanctioned-reason bucket, and both are asserted zero by separate mechanisms -- unsanctioned_work_starts() == 0 and 'zero uncaused evaluations' on the target fixtures. One invariant, two proofs, two models that must be kept in agreement by hand.

Delete Cause; the report reads the emitted reason. Reconcile the two zero-assertions into one.

Watch for a genuine distinction before merging: Readiness (settledness flipped, no revision moved) may not map cleanly onto a single WorkStartReason. If it is a real second axis, keep it as one -- do not flatten two different invariants into a lookalike.
title: Fold Cause into one vocabulary for why work ran
